description: This source file defines a set of unit tests for the TalkPromptBuilder component, verifying its behavior in constructing prompts with transcripts, interruption hints, and voice directives.

classes.name: TalkPromptBuilderTests
classes.description: A set of unit tests for the TalkPromptBuilder class, verifying prompt construction logic.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesTranscript
methods.description: Verifies that the prompt includes the transcript with the correct suffix and the 'Talk Mode active.' message.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesInterruptionLineWhenProvided
methods.description: Checks that the prompt contains the interruption notification when an interruption time is provided.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesVoiceDirectiveHintByDefault
methods.description: Ensures that the default prompt contains the voice directive hint.

methods.name: testBuildExcludesVoiceDirectiveHintWhenDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that disabling the voice directive hint leads to its absence in the prompt, while still including 'Talk Mode active.'
